title: Model colimit from a base colimit and final pushout squares
statement: Let Λ be a small nonempty directed preorder, Rfun,Sfun : Λ → CommRing functors, η : Rfun → Sfun a natural transformation, cR,cS cocones, and φ : cR.pt → cS.pt a morphism. Assume that for every l the square (η_l,π_l,κ_l,φ) is a pushout and that cR is a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then cS is a colimit. No finite-type, finite-presentation, or transition-pushout assumption is needed.

proof.text: For a cocone s on Sfun, compose its natural transformation with η to obtain a cocone base(s) on Rfun. Let g = hcolR.desc(base(s)). Its factorization at l says η_l followed by s_l equals π_l followed by g. Apply IsPushout.desc at l to obtain d_l : cS.pt → s.pt, with κ_l d_l = s_l and φ d_l = g.

If l ≤ m, cocone naturality gives κ_l d_m = Sfun(l→m) κ_m d_m = Sfun(l→m) s_m = s_l. Both d_l and d_m also have φ-composite g, so IsPushout.hom_ext at l gives d_l = d_m. A common upper bound makes d_l = d_m for arbitrary l,m. Nonemptiness permits a chosen l₀, and d_l₀ therefore factors every leg.

For another factorization m, the κ_l₀-composite is prescribed. For every l, π_l φ m = η_l κ_l m = η_l s_l = π_l g. Base-colimit hom_ext implies φ m = g. Pushout hom_ext at l₀ now implies m = d_l₀. This supplies the desc, fac, uniq fields of IsColimit cS.

mathlib_searches.results: Hits include IsPushout.of_isColimit_cocone and pushout pasting lemmas. Their types concern individual span colimits, not transfer of a directed base cocone colimit.
Read IsPushout.desc, inl_desc, inr_desc, hom_ext and IsColimit.fac/hom_ext. These prove the argument directly; no exact transfer theorem found.

theorem colimits_of_limit_finite_presentation_core
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ]
    [IsDirected Λ (fun a b => a ≤ b)]
    {Rfun Sfun : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat} (η : Rfun ⟶ Sfun)
    (cR : Cocone Rfun) (cS : Cocone Sfun) (φ : cR.pt ⟶ cS.pt)
    (hpush : ∀ l, Nonempty (CategoryTheory.IsPushout (η.app l) (cR.ι.app l) (cS.ι.app l) φ))
    (hcolR : IsColimit cR) : Nonempty (IsColimit cS)
